d: The Indian Army is deploying robotic mules along the Line of Control in Jammu and Kashmir. These four-legged machines can climb steep slopes, cross rivers, carry ammunition, and scan their surroundings using 360-degree cameras and thermal sensors. Designed to operate in extreme weather and difficult terrain, they are part of India's wider push to modernise border surveillance. From AI-powered monitoring to counter-drone systems, IGR looks at how robotic technology is changing security along the India-Pakistan border.
